verdict.rationale: PII filtering is a fair axis for a web-scraping library, but nothing in the evidence shows Crawl4AI detecting or redacting personally identifiable information. Its content filters (Fit Markdown, BM25) remove noise and irrelevant text, not PII, and its LLM extraction is only a building block a developer could use to construct redaction. A community comment notes that avoiding 'hoovering up PII' is a production concern users must handle themselves.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically detect and filter personally identifiable information out of scraped content before it reaches storage
